title: Long shallow bow shoulders and coordinated foredeck proportions
changes: Redistributed plan narrowing into a long shallow shoulder before the steep V; lengthened the closed foredeck to 1600, moved hatch centre to 1200 and coordinated pad/dashboard/footwell while keeping the well at 4000.
